Kaiku Health is your companion throughout your cancer treatment. It helps you to report your symptoms directly to your care team. Your care team is notified of any changes and will stay updated on your well-being.

How Kaiku Health supports you during your cancer treatment:

Tracking your symptoms
Report your symptoms and get feedback on how they’ve developed since the last report. Your care team will receive notifications of your reported symptoms and their development and will be up to date on your well-being.

Patients at select clinics can also share trends in their Apple Health activity data with their care teams.

Messaging
You are always just one message away from your care team. If you have non-urgent questions related to your treatment or symptoms, you can send a message to your care team. It is also possible to share attachments with your care team, such as a photo of your symptom. You can also access your previous messages with members of the care team whenever needed.

Note that Kaiku Health is meant for non-urgent communication. In urgent matters always be in direct contact with your care team, the ER or call the emergency line.

Information on your treatment
Your care team can add all important instructions and information related to your treatment to Kaiku Health. They travel with you and are readily accessible whenever needed.


Using Kaiku Health requires an invitation from your care team. Follow these steps to get started.

1. Register
Once your nurse or doctor has invited you to use Kaiku Health you will receive clear instructions by email.

2. Sign in
Sign in to the service with your personal username and password.

3. Start using Kaiku Health
Your care team has prepared everything for you based on your individual treatment plan. You can start reporting your symptoms and using other features right away.

The Kaiku Health app is currently in use in some of the clinics using Kaiku Health. Some features may be hospital or clinic specific. If you are not sure if the app is available to you, you can ask a member of your care team or contact Kaiku Health support.

This application consists of three modules: RECORDER, SMART ALARM, STOP SNORING.

RECORDER
Records your talk or snoring while you are asleep (automatic or manual sensitivity level, records only snoring using smart snoring detection), creates the graph of noise in room during the night, takes the total time of snoring down.

SMART ALARM
Helps you wake up easy in your lightest sleep phase and allows you to get up relaxed every morning. Improve your sleep naturally, maximize your sleep efficiency. 

STOP SNORING
Tries to stop your snoring by playing chosen sound or using iPhone vibration when the snoring is detected.

By using the tracker data and by defining your own factors (activities/means/drugs/custom notes) it is possible to find out which facts influence your sleep positively and limit your snoring. At your disposal there are beautiful statistic charts for simple and efficient analyzing of your sleeps/nights.

Snoring detection is based on artificial intelligence (A.I.) with the support of a new Apple machine learning technology. By using a large number of snoring samples, we can achieve high accuracy in statistics and in snoring detection itself.

How to place your device correctly is shown in instructions.
